The `20260317000001` migration explicitly added FORCE RLS to member (L28-32) and attendance (L93-96) schemas with the stated intent of preventing owner-level bypass. The oauth schema (timestamped `20260318`, i.e., created *after* the hardening migration) omits this. `oauth.cleanup_expired_codes()` (L99-108) is confirmed `SECURITY DEFINER`, already operating on `oauth.authorization_codes` which has a `USING(false)` deny-all policy.

Immediate exploitability is limited (existing SECURITY DEFINER only deletes expired codes), but the architectural gap is real and the pattern break against an explicit security hardening migration is notable. Medium is appropriate.
